faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the ProBook 450/455/470 G3 and G4 series, which share the same chassis. Since this range was sold with both backlit and non-backlit keyboards, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp to confirm your exact variant.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this is the non-backlit version. We also stock the backlit version for the same series.
